action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 coverage of all legal root moves before any commit
action.rationale: Feedback requires a broad search: candidate_moves=[], phase broad_search, no prior analyses. Position is a middlegame with both sides developed; concrete tactics may exist around the b4 bishop, the a6 knight and the d5/e5 knights. Use half the node budget (3000) at target depth 4 to get exact/upper-bound rows over every root, then replan a focused verification.
